title: Install Setu
excerpt: Install the Setu control panel on a fresh Ubuntu or Debian server with one command.
seo_description: Install the Setu control panel on Ubuntu 22.04/24.04/26.04 or Debian 12/13 (x86_64 or aarch64) with one command, then add a server and your first app.

attrs.text: You need a fresh Ubuntu 22.04, 24.04 or 26.04, or Debian 12 or 13, server (x86_64 or aarch64), root access, ports 80 and 443 open, and a DNS name pointing at the server. The installer brings PostgreSQL and Caddy itself.
The script verifies the release archive against SHA256SUMS, installs /opt/setu/setu, creates the setu user and database, configures Caddy for the panel host and starts setu.service.
No DNS name yet? Use --tls internal to have Caddy issue certificates from its own internal CA instead of ACME.
The installer prints https://panel.example.com/setup and a one-time setup token. Open the URL and paste the token.
The wizard creates the owner account. This works exactly once.
The wizard registers this server: run the setu agent install line it shows, as root. The server shows online within seconds.
Apps, Add: paste or link an app manifest.
New site: choose the app and a domain. Setu provisions the site, and it goes live with HTTPS, its own database, limits and a nightly backup.
All installer flags, the manual install, upgrading and uninstalling are covered in the installation guide. Sample app manifests, including Miniflux and hello-axum, are in the manifests repository.
